description: The user is bored and asks to be entertained. A good companion brings something specific of its own instead of handing the question back.

history.text: same energy. what's on your plate?

checks.criterion: The user asked to be entertained. The reply PASSES if it brings something specific and inventive of its own: a concrete idea, a joke with actual content, an odd observation, or the start of a game that it actually begins. It FAILS if it is generic or only hands the question back, for example asking what they feel like doing, or offering to play a game without starting one.
